name: fix-arm-c
description: Option C fix pipeline (linear v2): fix-dev writes the fix AND the tests (green check); a forge/run STRENGTH gate on the volume verifies coverage-not-dropped + no test deleted/skipped/reduced + new/changed behaviour tests RED on the pre-fix source (git works here, unlike the agent's files-only check sandbox); an independent test-auditor then files a PASS/FAIL on test weakening. Per-run cache. Inputs {task, namespace, repo, ref}.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: the PR branch to fix (base for coverage + regression proof)

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}"; echo "working on branch ${inputs.ref}:"; git log --oneline -1

set +e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; REF="${inputs.ref}"; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); FIX=$(git rev-parse HEAD); F=""; DEL=$(git diff --diff-filter=D --name-only "$BASE" "$FIX" -- '*_test.go'); [ -z "$DEL" ] || F="$F; deleted test file(s): $DEL"; SK=$(git diff "$BASE" "$FIX" -- '*_test.go' | grep -E '^\+' | grep -c '\.Skip('); [ "${SK:-0}" -eq 0 ] || F="$F; added ${SK} t.Skip()"; BF=$(git grep -hE '^func (Test|Fuzz|Benchmark)[A-Z]' "$BASE" -- '*_test.go' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); FF=$(git grep -hE '^func (Test|Fuzz|Benchmark)[A-Z]' "$FIX" -- '*_test.go' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "${FF:-0}" -ge "${BF:-0}" ] || F="$F; test funcs dropped ${BF} -> ${FF}"; TF=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" "$FIX" -- '*_test.go' | grep -v '^$'); [ -n "$TF" ] || F="$F; no *_test.go added or changed"; rm -rf /tmp/base; git worktree prune 2>/dev/null; git worktree add -f --detach /tmp/base "$BASE" >/dev/null 2>&1; FCOV=$(go test ./... -coverprofile=/tmp/fc >/dev/null 2>&1 && go tool cover -func=/tmp/fc 2>/dev/null | awk '/^total:/{gsub("%","",$3);print $3}'); BCOV=$( ( cd /tmp/base && go test ./... -coverprofile=/tmp/bc >/dev/null 2>&1 && go tool cover -func=/tmp/bc 2>/dev/null | awk '/^total:/{gsub("%","",$3);print $3}' ) ); FCOV=${FCOV:-0}; BCOV=${BCOV:-0}; awk -v f="$FCOV" -v b="$BCOV" 'BEGIN{exit !(f+1.0>=b)}' || F="$F; coverage dropped ${BCOV}% -> ${FCOV}%"; if [ -n "$TF" ]; then for f in $TF; do mkdir -p "/tmp/base/$(dirname "$f")"; cp "$f" "/tmp/base/$f"; done;   if ( cd /tmp/base && go build ./... >/dev/null 2>&1 && go test ./... >/tmp/rt 2>&1 ); then F="$F; your new/changed tests PASS on the pre-fix source (they do not pin the fix -- assert the new behaviour so they fail without it)"; fi; fi; git worktree remove --force /tmp/base 2>/dev/null; if [ -n "$F" ]; then echo "STRENGTH: FAIL (coverage ${BCOV}% -> ${FCOV}%, test funcs ${BF} -> ${FF})" > STRENGTH.md; echo "Fix these:$F" | tr ';' '\n' >> STRENGTH.md; else echo "STRENGTH: PASS (coverage ${BCOV}% -> ${FCOV}%, test funcs ${BF} -> ${FF}, red-on-base holds: $TF)" > STRENGTH.md; fi; git add STRENGTH.md; git -c user.email=bs@ca -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q -m 'chore(strength): verdict' || true; echo '=== STRENGTH.md ==='; cat STRENGTH.md; [ -z "$F" ] || { echo 'STRENGTHGATE FAIL'; exit 1; }; echo 'STRENGTHGATE OK'

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/${inputs.ref}"); mkdir -p .review; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- '*_test.go' > .review/tests.diff; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- '*.go' ':(exclude)*_test.go' > .review/code.diff; git add -A .review; git -c user.email=bs@ca -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q -m 'chore(review): audit diff snapshots' || true; echo "tests.diff $(wc -l < .review/tests.diff) lines; code.diff $(wc -l < .review/code.diff) lines"

with.task: Audit the test changes for the fix of this finding. Read .review/tests.diff and .review/code.diff. Finding: ${inputs.task}

with.run: set -e; cd /workspace; [ -f AUDIT.md ] || { echo 'AUDIT FAIL: no AUDIT.md verdict'; exit 1; }; echo '=== AUDIT.md ==='; cat AUDIT.md; echo '==='; if head -1 AUDIT.md | grep -qE '^VERDICT: PASS'; then echo 'AUDIT OK'; exit 0; fi; echo 'AUDIT FAIL: auditor flagged weakened/bypassed tests'; exit 1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/${inputs.ref}"); echo '=== STAT ==='; git diff --stat "$BASE" HEAD -- . ':(exclude).review'; echo '=== DIFF ==='; git diff "$BASE" HEAD -- . ':(exclude).review' ':(exclude)STRENGTH.md' | head -450; echo '=== STRENGTH.md ==='; cat STRENGTH.md 2>/dev/null; echo '=== AUDIT.md ==='; cat AUDIT.md 2>/dev/null
